options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file in which the object will be defined.

options.name: host
options.description: The hostname/IP address of the remote Icinga 2 instance. Configures this Icinga 2 instance to actively connect to the given Endpoint.

options.name: log_duration
options.description: Duration for keeping replay logs on connection loss. Attribute is specified in seconds. If log_duration is set to 0, replaying logs is disabled. You could also specify the value in human readable format like 10m for 10 minutes or 1h for one hour.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Endpoint object.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the remote Icinga 2 instance.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the Endpoint object.
